pronunciation.approximation: Say "simargl" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Simargl".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "simargl" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Simargl" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Simargl
domains.subtitle: Winged Guardian
domains.lead: Simargl is winged guardian, plant life. The name means "From Simurgh (Iranian)" and belongs to the slavic tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Simargl place winged guardian, plant life at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Simargl appears in slavic tradition as winged guardian, plant life. The name's meaning, "From Simurgh (Iranian)", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Simargl in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Simargl remains a touchstone for understanding slavic religion, art, and identity.
